headline: President Obama created a new advisory commission to study ethical questions raised by advances in science, medicine, and technology.
what_it_does: This executive order set up the Presidential Commission for the Study of Bioethical Issues. Based on the title, the commission's job is to study and advise the President on ethical issues tied to biomedical science and related research. The order itself does not appear to create new rules for the public.

who_it_affects.how: Their fields and research practices may be studied by the commission, which could shape advice given to the President.
They serve on a new federal advisory body that studies bioethics questions.
